prev.speaker: Ponticius
prev.text: "Contract's signed. Don't die before you get there."

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text: The next morning, the party rides out through the east gate under a grey sky.

prev.speaker: Max
prev.text: "Where's Ponticius? I thought he'd be here."

prev.speaker: DM Narrator
prev.text: A barmaid points toward a snoring heap by the hearth.

next.speaker: Arin
next.text: "We'll talk to him later that day, once he's slept it off. Sit down, finish your ale."

prev.speaker: Arin
prev.text: "Then it's settled. We ride at first light."

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text:
* * *
The ruins rise out of the desert like broken teeth, gold light bleeding from their cracks.

prev.speaker: Mae Hollis
prev.text: "So we wait for Brandt to make a mistake."

prev.speaker: Max
prev.text: "He already made one. He got greedy."

next.speaker: Narrator
next.text: Max walked over to the window and looked down at the rain-slick street below the office.

prev.speaker: Arin
prev.text: "Keep your hood up. The wind up here takes skin."

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text: By the time the caravan reached Hollow Pass, the snow had melted from the peaks and Luke had grown two inches.

prev.speaker: Ponticius
prev.text: "The ferry leaves at noon. Be on it."

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text: Salt spray stings your face. Gulls wheel overhead as the ferry pulls away from the dock and the city shrinks behind you.

prev.speaker: Arin
prev.text: Arin turns her cup slowly on the table.

next.speaker: Arin
next.text: "Years later, I still dream about that thing," she says, staring into her cup. "Its eyes, mostly."

prev.speaker: Arin
prev.text: "Get some sleep. I'll take first watch."

prev.speaker: Max
prev.text: *I pull the blanket up to my chin.*

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text: You drift off to the crackle of the fire. You wake to birdsong and Arin kicking your boot.

prev.speaker: Arin
prev.text: "If he's late one more time, I'm taking the job myself."

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text: The door bangs open and Ponticius strides in, shaking rain from his cloak.

prev.speaker: Mae Hollis
prev.text: "Tommy's safe for tonight. Go home, get some sleep."

next.speaker: Narrator
next.text: Meanwhile, across town, Lieutenant Brandt counts a stack of bills in the back of a closed bakery.

prev.speaker: DM Narrator
prev.text: Two guards rush you from the gatehouse, blades drawn.

prev.speaker: Max
prev.text: I duck the first swing and shoulder the man into the wall.

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text: The second guard lunges; Arin parries and drives him back against the crates.

prev.speaker: HALO
prev.text: "Pell's service record includes a similar incident."

next.speaker: Pell
next.text: "When we arrived at the station last year, the reactor was already cracked. Same flicker, same smell."

prev.speaker: Arin
prev.text: "Ask me that again and I'm leaving you on this mountain."

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text: Hours of climbing later, the party arrives at the gates of the Sun Ruins.

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text: A la mañana siguiente, el grupo parte hacia las ruinas bajo un cielo gris.

next.speaker: Arin
next.text: "Mañana hablaremos con él otra vez. Ahora, a dormir."

prev.speaker: Arin
prev.text: "My brother used to talk like that. All plans, no fear."

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text: As night fell around the campfire, Arin kept talking, her voice low, about the brother she lost at Kell's Ford.

next.speaker: Narrator
next.text: Two days later, the Long Dark limps into dock at Ceres Station, patched hull groaning.

prev.speaker: Graves
prev.text: "The attic is closed to guests, sir."

next.speaker: Max
next.text: When the house is asleep, I leave my room and climb the servants' stairs to the attic, candle in hand.

next.speaker: Narrator
next.text: A long silence stretches between you. Somewhere in the house, a clock ticks.

prev.speaker: Mae Hollis
prev.text: "Get some rest. Tomorrow we pull the payroll records."

next.speaker: Narrator
next.text:
---
The precinct at three in the morning is all cold coffee and ringing phones.

prev.speaker: Graves
prev.text: "Everything is as you left it, sir."

next.speaker: Narrator
next.text: The scene in the gallery is exactly as Graves described: three candles, one portrait, and the smell of smoke.

next.speaker: Max
next.text: *A week passes. My arm heals, the rain stops, and I finally go back to Mercer Street.*
